en.title: Dense Play menus and controller navigation
en.body: Hidden Play labels release their borrowed raster and prepare their current words on reveal. BrowserGame exposes label queue, cache and release counts. Declarative modals can use a standard controller to navigate, confirm, dismiss or resume while gameplay is paused.

zh.title: Play 密集菜单与手柄导航
zh.body: Play 标签隐藏后释放借用的文字纹理，重新显示时准备最新文案。BrowserGame 提供排队、缓存和释放计数。声明式模态可在玩法暂停时用标准手柄导航、确认、关闭和继续。
